cases.items.businessCenter.task: Common-area cleaning relied on a contractor crew: high turnover, quality varied from shift to shift and rates went up every year.
cases.items.businessCenter.solution: Robotic floor scrubbers clean the lobby and corridors on schedule, with tasks and reports in the platform. People stayed on restrooms and spot jobs.
cases.items.agro.task: Fields were sprayed with ground machinery: excess product on overlaps, wheel ruts in the crop, and a spraying window that depended on the weather.
cases.items.agro.solution: Agricultural drones spray along flight plans on a field map. We set the rate and route per field. Economics are counted per season, not per month.
cases.items.warehouse.task: Pickers spent most of the shift walking between racks. In peak weeks the warehouse hit the limit of people on shift.
cases.items.warehouse.solution: Autonomous mobile robots (AMR) bring racks to the picking stations. Tasks come from the WMS through the platform.
cases.items.manufacturing.task: Operators stood at the machines the whole shift: load a blank, unload a part. There were not enough people for a second shift.
cases.items.manufacturing.solution: A collaborative robot arm on a mobile base loads and unloads the machines, moving from one to the next. The operator watches the area, not every part.
cases.items.construction.task: Manual demolition: a crew with jackhammers, vibration, dust and a risk of collapse next to people. Deadlines slipped for lack of workers.
cases.items.construction.solution: A remote-controlled demolition robot: the operator works from a safe distance and the machine takes the heavy part of the job.

cases.method.title: A case study without a method is a promise. So we show how we calculate.
cases.method.lead: Every figure can be rechecked: we state the baseline, the period and what is included. We don’t round to nice numbers: 32% is more accurate than “about a third”.
cases.method.cost.title: Cost reduction, %
cases.method.cost.aria: Costs before minus costs after, divided by costs before, times one hundred percent
cases.method.cost.text: Periods are comparable. For labor the baseline is person-hours; for crop protection products, liters per hectare per season.
cases.method.payback.title: Payback, months
cases.method.payback.aria: Client investment divided by monthly savings
cases.method.payback.text: Savings are the same before-and-after cost difference as in the first formula.
cases.method.staff.title: Staff freed up
cases.method.staff.text: In FTEs, not in people. People usually move to other jobs on the site.
cases.method.growth.title: Productivity gain, %
cases.method.growth.aria: After minus before, divided by before, times one hundred percent
cases.method.growth.text: For a warehouse: orders or lines per shift with the same staff.
